import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {

    static final int maxn = 510;
    static long[][] c = new long[maxn][maxn];
    static long[] dp_con = new long[maxn];
    static long[] sum_con = new long[maxn];
    static long[][] dp = new long[maxn][maxn];
    static long[][] sum = new long[maxn][maxn];
    
    static int n, m, mod;

    static long Arth(long n_val) {
        return n_val * (n_val + 1) / 2 % mod;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        m = scanner.nextInt();
        mod = scanner.nextInt();
        
        // Precompute binomial coefficients
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            c[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                c[i][j] = (c[i-1][j] + c[i-1][j-1]) % mod;
            }
        }
        
        // Initialize dp_con and sum_con
        dp_con[0] = 1;
        dp_con[1] = 2;
        sum_con[0] = 0;
        sum_con[1] = 0;
        
        for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) {
            dp_con[i] = 0;
            sum_con[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                long rcon = dp_con[j] * dp_con[i - j - 1] % mod;
                rcon = rcon * c[i-1][j] % mod;
                
                dp_con[i] = (dp_con[i] + rcon * (i + 1) % mod) % mod;
                
                long term1 = (dp_con[j] * sum_con[i - j - 1] % mod + sum_con[j] * dp_con[i - j - 1] % mod) % mod;
                term1 = term1 * c[i-1][j] % mod * (i + 1) % mod;
                sum_con[i] = (sum_con[i] + term1) % mod;
                
                long term2 = rcon * (Arth(j) + Arth(i - 1 - j)) % mod;
                sum_con[i] = (sum_con[i] + term2) % mod;
            }
            dp_con[i] %= mod;
            sum_con[i] %= mod;
        }
        
        // Initialize dp
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                if (dp[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int k = 1; k + i <= m; k++) {
                        dp[i + k][j + 1] = (dp[i + k][j + 1] + dp[i][j] * dp_con[k] % mod * c[i + k][k]) % mod;
                        
                        long term1 = (dp[i][j] * sum_con[k] % mod + sum[i][j] * dp_con[k] % mod) % mod;
                        term1 = term1 * c[i + k][k] % mod;
                        sum[i + k][j + 1] = (sum[i + k][j + 1] + term1) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (n - (m - 1 + j) < 0) break;
            long comb = c[n - (m - 1 + j) + j][j];
            ans = (ans + sum[m][j] * comb % mod) % mod;
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
